errorCodes.meaning: The recipient holds no group state for `roomId` as `member` — or `member` is not one the caller may act as, which is answered the same way so that the error does not say which members of which rooms the recipient serves. A room absent from rooms/keys/list for this member cannot be labelled.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

PersonalLabel.description: A member's personal label for one room, as their key holder keeps it: at least one detail (`minProperties` counts `updatedAt`), and when it last changed. A key holder that holds no detail for the room holds no label, and returns none — there is no empty label.

updatedAt.description: When the label last changed, as the key holder recorded it. A request that changed nothing does not move it.

PersonalLabel.title: PersonalLabel

PersonalLabelDescription.description: What the room is to the member, in a sentence or a short paragraph. Line breaks and tabs are allowed; other control characters are not.
PersonalLabelDescription.title: PersonalLabelDescription

PersonalLabelName.description: The member's own name for the room, on one line: no control characters, line breaks included. Shown before every name a third party gave the room, because it is the only one nobody else wrote.
PersonalLabelName.title: PersonalLabelName

PersonalLabelNotes.description: Longer free-form notes the member keeps about the room: who introduced them, what to look for in it, what they agreed there. Line breaks and tabs are allowed; other control characters are not.
PersonalLabelNotes.title: PersonalLabelNotes

PersonalLabelTag.description: A word or short phrase the member files the room under, in any script, so their own surfaces can group and filter their rooms. Compared exactly, as a string: a key holder does not case-fold or normalise it.
PersonalLabelTag.title: PersonalLabelTag

PersonalLabelTags.description: The member's tags for the room, one to sixteen, as a set: order carries no meaning. A room with no tags has no `tags` member, never an empty list, so there is one way to say "none".
PersonalLabelTags.title: PersonalLabelTags

Response.description: Success response to rooms/keys/label. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/rooms/keys/label/0.1#response. The label as it now stands, and whether this request changed it.

changed.description: `false` when every value given already matched, and every detail named for removal was already absent: nothing was written and `updatedAt` did not move. A retried request answers `false`, which is what makes the task safe to repeat.

personal.description: The label as it now stands. Absent when no detail remains: removing the last one removes the label.

schema.description: Set, change or remove the member's own personal label for one room they hold: its name, description, notes and tags, kept by their key holder for their eyes only. Each detail given replaces the stored one; a detail absent is unchanged; `removeX` removes one. At least one change is required (`minProperties` counts `roomId` and `member`; `ext` is not a change, which Recipient item 3 holds), and a detail cannot be both given and removed. Nothing here reaches the room, its host, its owner or a community. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

description.description: The member's new description, replacing any they had. Absent: unchanged.

label.description: The member's new name for the room, replacing any they had. Absent: unchanged.

member.description: The member whose label this is: the DID the room admitted, as rooms/keys/list 0.2 returns it beside the room. REQUIRED, never inferred, because a person holding one room as two personas keeps a label for each, and a label written under the wrong one is shown in the wrong context.

notes.description: The member's new notes, replacing any they had. Absent: unchanged.

removeDescription.description: Remove the member's description. Only `true` is accepted.

removeLabel.description: Remove the member's name for the room. Only `true` is meaningful, so only `true` is accepted. A separate member rather than `label: null`, because a nullable optional member makes "unchanged" and "remove" the same value in libraries that map both to one absent option.

removeNotes.description: Remove the member's notes. Only `true` is accepted.

removeTags.description: Remove every tag. Only `true` is accepted.

roomId.description: The room's identifier: its DID, as rooms/keys/list returns it.

tags.description: The member's tags, replacing the whole set. Absent: unchanged. Remove every tag with `removeTags`.

schema.title: Rooms Keys Label — payload
